channel.title: AI Tools & Models HOT
channel.description: Daily AI model releases and leading agent updates, scored by rules from 20 sources (17 RSS feeds + 3 Hugging Face org pages). Titles, one-line summaries and links only — no full text republished.

item.title: v1.0.0-alpha.2
item.description: OpenAI Agents SDK ships v1.0.0-alpha.2, a preview release that keeps refining the agent-building toolkit ahead of the 1.0 launch.

item.title: v2.4.1
item.description: Open-source terminal agent OpenCode ships v2.4.1, with no detailed release notes attached this time.

item.title: Finding faster quantum algorithms with agents and formal verification
item.description: DeepMind pairs multi-agent teams with formal verification to find faster quantum algorithms for fusion and chemistry.

item.title: Qwen Code Desktop v0.28.4
item.description: Qwen Code Desktop ships v0.28.4, strengthening end-to-end tests for scheduled loops and state checks in PR verification.

item.title: v2.4.0
item.description: OpenCode ships v2.4.0; the release notes list no specific changes, so this is a routine version bump.

item.title: A more tailored Google Search that's uniquely yours
item.description: Google Search's Personal Intelligence draws on Gmail, Drive and Photos to tailor results to each user.

item.title: RoboTrack: Point tracking for real-world robotic manipulation
item.description: AllenAI releases the RoboTrack benchmark and 15 million simulated point tracks, plus two point-tracking models that help robots keep following target points during grasping, pipetting, and other manipulation tasks.

item.title: Release v0.28.4
item.description: Qwen Code ships v0.28.4, a small maintenance release polishing CI and the managed-agent service, including changes to the manual re-review flow — a quick upgrade for everyday users.

item.title: Connected intelligence for in-house legal
item.description: OpenAI brings together legal and consulting voices to show how AI can help corporate legal teams link business context and reuse proven workflows.

item.title: How to build and maintain an agentic evaluation
item.description: Hugging Face shares a practical method for building and maintaining an evaluation system for agents, helping developers measure real agent performance more reliably.

item.title: Perplexity and Intelligence
item.description: OpenAI explains how perplexity measures model progress and gives developers a shared way to evaluate emerging capabilities.
